name: anstar-sales-crm
description: Bounded read-only Sales workflows for Anstar CRM.

interface.longDescription: Use accessible Anstar CRM evidence to analyse account signals, prioritise existing accounts, prepare for named meetings, review weekly pipeline risk, and answer bounded CRM questions without changing records.
defaultPrompt: What can you do for an Anstar seller?
What changed for this account, and which accounts should I focus on this week?
Prepare me for this meeting, then review my open pipeline for the previous seven days.
